request.purpose: Count GW008 Results missing competition_key that are deterministically buildable
request.sql: SELECT COUNT(*) AS missing_total, SUM(CASE WHEN competition_group='DOMESTIC' AND sm_action='league' AND sm_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sm_country)<>'' AND sm_division IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sm_division)<>'' THEN 1 WHEN competition_group='DOMESTIC' AND sm_action IN ('leaguecup','leagueshield','charityshield') AND sm_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sm_country)<>'' THEN 1 WHEN competition_group='INTERNATIONAL' AND sm_action IN ('smfacup','smfashield','supercup') THEN 1 WHEN competition_group='NATIONS' AND sm_action IN ('worldcup','interqualifier') THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS buildable, SUM(CASE WHEN NOT ((competition_group='DOMESTIC' AND sm_action='league' AND sm_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sm_country)<>'' AND sm_division IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sm_division)<>'') OR (competition_group='DOMESTIC' AND sm_action IN ('leaguecup','leagueshield','charityshield') AND sm_country IS NOT NULL AND TRIM(sm_country)<>'') OR (competition_group='INTERNATIONAL' AND sm_action IN ('smfacup','smfashield','supercup')) OR (competition_group='NATIONS' AND sm_action IN ('worldcup','interqualifier'))) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS unresolved FROM `GW008_IMC Results` WHERE game_world_id='GW008' AND (competition_key IS NULL OR TRIM(competition_key)='')
